critical_code_review_comments: BackgroundTasks migration is clean: both /api/leads and /api/ppa-inquiries now receive `background_tasks: BackgroundTasks` and call `background_tasks.add_task(_send_lead_email_sync, 'Lead', html)`. This is the correct FastAPI pattern and avoids the create_task GC pitfall. Good fix.

_send_lead_email_sync duplicates the api_key check + try/except/logging from _send_lead_email. The async _send_lead_email helper is now unused — consider deleting it to keep the module DRY (minor; ~20 lines of dead code).

SENDER_EMAIL is still onboarding@resend.dev (Resend sandbox). Delivery is restricted to the Resend account owner mailbox until sunmacsolar.com.au is verified. One historical ERROR line ('sunmacsolar.com.au domain is not verified') was observed in the log from an earlier attempt with a custom sender — current sandbox sender does NOT hit this. Track domain verification as pre-launch task.
server.py is now 340 lines — still under the 700-line split threshold, but as more endpoints/emails/routers are added, consider splitting into routers/, models/, emails/.

Playwright's bundled Chromium build lacks proprietary h264 codec, so the video element hits MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED inside automated tests. This is a Playwright limitation only — real Chrome/Edge/Safari/Firefox users will play the video normally. Verified codec/container/faststart by ffprobe; no code fix required.
